description: Lint every edited file with oxlint (PostToolUse) and block edits that turn an oxlint rule off (PreToolUse). Both hooks run from TypeScript source under Deno: the linter is resolved only from the edited project's node_modules, never from PATH.

hooks.command: command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'oxlint-guard: deno not found on PATH - install Deno 2.x (https://deno.com) so the lint guard can run' >&2; exit 1; }; exec deno run --allow-read --allow-run --allow-env "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/lint-guard.ts"

command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'oxlint-guard: deno not found on PATH - install Deno 2.x (https://deno.com) so the config guard can run' >&2; exit 1; }; exec deno run --allow-read --allow-env "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/config-guard.ts"
